# Sky Continents V11

Sky Continents V11 is a datapack add-on for **Continents by Stardust Labs**. It turns the oceans between Continents-style massive landmasses into open void, creating huge sky continents separated by airspace instead of water.

This pack is designed for airship-focused gameplay, especially Create Aeronautics-style worlds where long-distance travel by flying machines is the main experience.

## Features

- Massive continent-scale landmasses
- Oceans become open void/airspace
- Vanilla terrain 

## Requirements

Sky Continents V11 requires the **Continents** datapack by Stardust Labs.

Install both datapacks and place **Sky Continents V11 above Continents** in datapack priority.

<details>
<summary>Legal Ponder</summary>

This pack does not include or redistribute Continents. It is an add-on designed to work alongside a separately installed copy of Continents.

</details>
